An original young woman with long, straight,
blunt-cut hair and wind-swept strands sits in a
black-and-white portrait. She wears a black leather
zip jacket with a wide collar and a twisted silver
hoop earring. Her expression is direct and intense.
A light gray seamless backdrop, high-contrast
studio lighting, and sharp shadows along the jaw.
Monochrome palette of black, white, and mid-gray.
